name: thumb-a
subject: Full-frame 16:9 cinematic collage poster: a sleek white humanoid robot sprinting toward the camera on a city road, mid-stride, leaning forward, printed as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, placed on the right half of the frame, over a bold torn deep-red paper background with a few torn warm-yellow paper strips and a faint halftone city skyline at the bottom, strong contrast, the left third of the frame left as plain empty red paper.

name: thumb-b
subject: Full-frame 16:9 cinematic collage poster: a humanoid robot runner overtaking a human marathon runner, both side view, both printed as black-and-white halftone engraved photographs cut out with thin white scissor borders, the robot slightly ahead and larger, on the right two thirds of the frame, over a torn deep-red paper background with one warm-yellow torn paper finish-line ribbon, the left third left as plain empty red paper.

name: plate-race
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: a wide modern Beijing avenue on an early spring morning seen at street level, glass office towers and a few bare trees, crowd barriers along the sides, made of layered torn paper and halftone engraved photo cut-outs, pale dusty-blue morning sky with torn white paper clouds, the center of the road left empty and calm for runners to be placed later.

name: robot-run
subject: One sleek humanoid robot running, full body, side view, mid-stride with one knee raised and arms swinging, smooth white and grey panels, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with scissors, thin white paper border following its silhouette, centered.

name: finish-arch
subject: One wide inflatable finish-line arch over a road, seen from the front, plain surface with no lettering, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, flat bottom edge, centered.

name: crowd
subject: A long horizontal strip of cheering spectators behind metal crowd barriers, many people seen from the front at waist height, some raising phones, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border along the tops of their heads, flat bottom edge.

name: stopwatch
subject: One classic silver mechanical stopwatch with a plain dial without numbers, slightly tilted, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, one warm-yellow accent on the crown button, centered.

name: plate-village
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: a poor rural Chinese village landscape in the late 1970s, flooded rice paddies, low mud-brick houses with tiled roofs, distant green hills, made of torn paper layers and sepia halftone engraved photo cut-outs, aged cream paper sky, calm and empty center.

name: bicycles
subject: A group of workers in 1970s blue work jackets riding old black bicycles, seen from the side, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, flat bottom edge, centered.

name: skyline-sz
subject: A dense modern skyline of very tall glass skyscrapers of a southern Chinese megacity, one supertall tower in the middle, seen from the front, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border along the rooftops, flat bottom edge.

name: cranes
subject: A container port with three tall ship-to-shore gantry cranes and stacked shipping containers, seen from the side, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, flat bottom edge, one warm-yellow accent on one container.

name: plate-circuit
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: a dark navy-blue paper sheet printed with faint engraved circuit-board traces and tiny dots, torn paper edges at the corners, subtle grain, calm and empty center.

name: whale
subject: One large whale swimming, side view, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with scissors, thin white paper border following its silhouette, tinted in dusty blue, centered.

name: chip
subject: One square computer processor chip with gold pins seen from above at a slight angle, plain top surface with no markings, as a halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, centered.

name: arrow-down
subject: One thick jagged red paper arrow pointing steeply downward like a crashing stock chart line, torn red paper with fibrous edges, centered.

name: servers
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: a long data center aisle with rows of server racks and blinking lights receding into the distance, as black-and-white halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper, a few dusty-blue torn paper accents, no text.

name: plate-desert
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: a vast desert plain under a pale dusty-blue sky with a big warm-yellow torn paper sun, low sand dunes of torn sepia paper, distant mountains, made of layered torn paper, calm empty foreground.

name: turbine
subject: One tall modern three-blade wind turbine, full height, front view, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border following its silhouette, vertical, centered.

name: solar
subject: A long row of tilted solar panels on metal frames seen from the side and slightly above, as a halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, dusty-blue tint on the panels, flat bottom edge.

name: pylon
subject: One tall steel high-voltage electricity pylon with hanging cables, full height, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, vertical, centered.

name: battery
subject: One large cylindrical lithium-ion battery cell standing upright, plain metal casing without any label, a small warm-yellow lightning-bolt shaped paper piece stuck on it, as a halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, centered.

name: solarfarm
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: an immense solar farm covering desert hills seen from high above, endless rows of panels following the terrain, wind turbines on the horizon, as halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper with dusty-blue and warm-yellow accents, no text.

name: plate-factory
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: the inside of a huge bright modern car factory hall, steel roof trusses, rows of lights, made of layered torn paper and black-and-white halftone engraved photo cut-outs, calm empty center floor.

name: ev-car
subject: One modern compact electric hatchback car, side view, generic design with no logo and no badges, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border following its silhouette, one warm-yellow accent on the charging port, centered.

name: robot-arm
subject: One orange-and-grey six-axis industrial robot arm on its base, articulated pose reaching forward, as a halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, centered.

name: car-ship
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: a huge roll-on roll-off car carrier ship docked at a port, hundreds of new cars lined up on the quay waiting to board, as black-and-white halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper, dusty-blue sea of torn paper, no text.

name: weld-line
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: a car body assembly line with many industrial robot arms welding car frames, bright sparks, as black-and-white halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper with warm-yellow spark accents, no text, no people.

name: plate-map
subject: Full-frame 16:9 background plate: an antique engraved world map on aged cream paper, oceans in faded dusty blue, coastlines only, no labels and no lettering, a hand-drawn compass rose in a corner, torn paper edges, calm.

name: ship-dutch
subject: One seventeenth-century Dutch three-masted sailing ship with full sails, side view, as a black-and-white engraving cut out with a thin white scissor border, centered.

name: train-steam
subject: One nineteenth-century British steam locomotive with a tall chimney and puffs of smoke, side view, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, flat bottom edge, centered.

name: skyscraper
subject: One tall 1930s art deco American skyscraper with a stepped spire, full height, as a black-and-white halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, vertical, centered.

name: train-hsr
subject: One sleek white modern high-speed bullet train with a long aerodynamic nose, side view, generic livery without any lettering, as a halftone engraved photograph cut out with a thin white scissor border, flat bottom edge, centered.

name: assembly
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: a 1990s electronics factory with long rows of workers in light uniforms assembling circuit boards at benches, seen from above at an angle, as black-and-white halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper with dusty-blue accents, no text.

name: border-river
subject: Full-frame 16:9 collage scene: a narrow river separating green fields and small houses on one bank from a row of high-rise towers on the other bank, as halftone engraved photograph layers on aged paper, dusty-blue torn paper water, no text.
